line: "Federal agencies often fail to appropriately manage their finances, identify clearly what they intend to accomplish, or get the job done effectively and with a minimum of waste."
Many agencies find themselves without a clear understanding of who they are or where they are headed.
Agencies [are held] accountable less for inputs and outputs than for outcomes.
The difference between the two measures is the key to understanding government performance.
Successful organizations… based their strategic planning… on the interests and expectations of their stakeholders.
Successful organizations… monitor their internal and external environments continuously and systematically.
